campaign.scope: Two stripes; fixed 2-of-3 rows; three destination domains; capacity one per destination; offline flags, retired slots and eligibility vary. Traces may repeat. Matching-only feasibility oracle; no process or power faults in this model campaign.

coding_campaign.scope: All 15 four-row subsets, two unit destinations, eligibility/offline/retired flags; not general concurrency or hardware proof

contingency_campaign.scope: Single 4+2 stripe; 4/5 live rows; 0/1/2 slots in each of X/Y; free/retired; one declared fault

limitations: Finite-model correctness is not an unbounded proof
Process exits are not power-loss tests
No comparative performance or novelty result is established

min_work_campaign.scope: 96 two-stripe 2+1 states plus 40 single-stripe states across both profiles; finite grammar

partial_campaign.scope: Exhaustive 40-case single-stripe matrix; not all partial-recovery states
